reference.title: XML prime output, session liveness, agent list rename
reference.summary: Three small improvements to ox agent surfaces. First, continued the ox agent prime XML-output redesign by removing the CACHE BOUNDARY XML-comment block that was wasting agent context tokens. Second, added agent process liveness detection to ox session status by combining two sources — disk instance-store PID checks via kill(pid,0) and daemon heartbeats — and surfaced the result as process_alive and process_status fields in JSON, with a styled warning for dead agent processes in text mode. Third, renamed 'Active AI coworkers' to 'Active SageOx enriched agents' in ox agent list output to reduce ambiguity about what the list actually represents.
key_actions: Removed CACHE BOUNDARY XML comment block from ox agent prime output
Added disk PID-check (kill(pid,0)) path for session liveness
Added daemon-heartbeat path for session liveness
Exposed process_alive and process_status fields in ox session status JSON
Added styled warning in text output when the agent process is dead
Renamed 'Active AI coworkers' to 'Active SageOx enriched agents' in ox agent list
